description: 3D LiDAR Point Cloud Dataset — Victoriaville Pedestrian Network is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Ali Ahmadi, Mir Abolfazl Mostafavi. Semantically segmented 3D LiDAR point cloud collected in Victoriaville, Quebec, Canada. Annotated with 35 classes in CloudCompare. CRS: NAD1983 MTM Zone 7. Used in: Ahmadi et al. (2026), Sensors. Coverage: national (CA); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
